Name: PC's Industrial Furniture
Author: PlatinumCats
Description:
[center]A slightly more modern twist of my Old World Furniture. Contains 20+ industrial-style furniture items.

[img=center]http://i.imgur.com/1WGMTGJ.png[/img]

The furniture in this pack were originally was one with PC's Old World Furniture, but as the mod develops and I added more items, I think the distinction between two styles were growing more and more. In the end I decided to split the mod into two.


This mod is using Content Patcher to add the furniture, and have built-in compatibility with Happy Home Designer and Calcifer. You can obtain the furniture via vanilla furniture catalogue, or if you have Calcifer mod installed you can buy them in their own dedicated catalogue sold by Robin for 75000g. Toggleable from Mod Option menu.


If you like this mod, don't forget to endorse! That way more people will see it and it'll give my modding spirit a boost. :D

Happy decorating![/center]
